verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents a Segments feature with attribute-based conditions. Its trigger docs mention profiles 'joining' segments when they meet attribute conditions, which implies membership updates as data changes. Example segments like 'Have not logged in recently' hint at behavioral criteria, and an AI 'Describe segment' helper can build segments from plain text. missing for 10: explicit documentation of tag-based segment conditions, explicit documentation of behavioral-event conditions in segments, clear documentation that segments update in real time, independent or hands-on corroboration.
